technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, AO, CMF) show bullish confluence but are offset by overbought conditions, stochastic bearish cross, and price trading below key moving averages (50-day), limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 30 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase vs 2 sales, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (365.44), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwind for multinational AON, and earnings event in 30 days creating binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (RSI-9 overbought, AO cross-up, CMF cross-up) with extreme fear sentiment (17/100) creates contrarian swing entry opportunity near support at 255.51.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), price below all key moving averages (EMA-50, SMA-50, Ichimoku cloud), stochastic bearish cross, overbought RSI-9 without trend confirmation (ADX 29.7), and high earnings risk in 30 days eliminate conviction for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum confluence (RSI-9, AO, CMF crosses) offers contrarian appeal at support with extreme fear sentiment (17/100). However, macro deterioration (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar) and price below all key moving averages eliminate conviction for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 30 days combined with severe macro headwinds (VIX 365.44, recession-signal yield curve) creates binary downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum signals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AON position with 38 existing Financials positions (14.8% sector concentration); adding to concentration during macro crisis and earnings proximity is imprudent.
